coverage_definitions.instance_coverage: source-supported target rows / all target rows

semantics.metric_labels: source-supported AND target-present, fixed per evaluation scope
semantics.positive_tie: absolute tie within tie_atol at positive maximum -> ABSTAIN
semantics.target_eval: target rows whose gold label is source-supported

settings.cosine_arithmetic: float32; prototype sums and norms in float32; target rows L2-normalised with a float64 norm; score = one fused multiply-add per target nonzero in ascending column order
settings.label_order: inventory: decreasing source frequency, ties in first-occurrence order; tie breaks and uniform-draw columns: names.FAMILY_ORDER (family) and the registry facet-map order (facet)
settings.uniform_sampler: multinomial(n, [1/k]*k) of numpy.random.default_rng(seed) (PCG64; binomial by inversion if n*p <= 30, else BTPE) with every a*b+c of the binomial algorithms rounded once (fused multiply-add); one stream per schedule row, labels in declared order
settings.volume_sampler: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).choice(pool, size=n, replace=False) per source label, labels in source-inventory order
